# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Test Management and Quality Engineering Lead with over 19 years of experience directing risk-based test strategies, quality governance, and end-to-end delivery across complex digital, cloud, and enterprise systems. Proven expertise leading multidisciplinary QA teams through defect triage, cloud platform migrations, and rigorous release readiness assessments to enforce quality gates and protect service reliability. Adept at driving continuous improvement and capability uplift by integrating automated test suites, Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and modern test tools in close collaboration with technical teams, business testers, and senior stakeholders.

## Core Competencies & Technical Skills
- **Test Management & Governance:** Risk-Based Test Strategy, Quality Frameworks & Governance, Test Scope & Schedule Management, Quality Gates & Entry/Exit Criteria, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Go-Live Risk Assessment & Release Readiness, End-to-End (E2E) & Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Coordination, Data Integrity Validation
- **Quality Engineering & Automation:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric, API Gateway Testing, Reusable Test Assets, Test Coverage Analysis
- **CI/CD & DevOps Engineering:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Slack API Integration, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), Static Analysis & Security Testing
- **Languages & Frameworks:** C#, Python, Kotlin, Java, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, React, Jetpack Compose
- **Tools & Methodologies:** Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM, Dynatrace, GitHub Copilot CLI, Generative AI Tooling
